context.conventions: Component-based architecture, hooks over classes, CSS modules or Tailwind

developer.extra_instructions: Use functional components with hooks. Follow React 19 patterns if detected. Prefer composition over inheritance.

tester.extra_instructions: Use React Testing Library for component tests. Test user interactions, not implementation details. Use MSW for API mocking.

ux-designer.extra_instructions: Consider React component composition patterns. Design with props/state boundaries in mind. Specify which state is local vs global.

pre_start: Detect package manager: check for pnpm-lock.yaml (pnpm), yarn.lock (yarn), package-lock.json (npm)

detect_start_command.note: Replace <pkg-manager> with detected: npm, pnpm, or yarn

dev-runner.working_directory: Detect: if frontend is in a subdirectory (e.g., ./frontend/), cd into it

check_order.note: If serve not installed, run: npm install -g serve OR npx serve
